title: WAVE: Warp-Based View Guidance for Consistent Novel View Synthesis Using a Single Image
title_zh: WAVE：基于扭曲的视角引导，实现单图像一致的新视角合成
abstract: Generating high-quality novel views of a scene from a single image requires maintaining structural coherence across different views, referred to as view consistency. While diffusion models have driven advancements in novel view synthesis, they still struggle to preserve spatial continuity across views. Diffusion models have been combined with 3D models to address the issue, but such approaches lack efficiency due to their complex multi-step pipelines. This paper proposes a novel view-consistent image generation method which utilizes diffusion models without additional modules. Our key idea is to enhance diffusion models with a trainingfree method that enables adaptive attention manipulation and noise reinitialization by leveraging view-guided warping to ensure view consistency. Through our comprehensive metric framework suitable for novel-view datasets, we show that our method improves view consistency across various diffusion models, demonstrating its broader applicability ${ }^{1}$ 11Project page: jwoo-park0.github.io/wave
abstract_zh: 从单张图像生成高质量的新视角场景，需要在不同视角间保持结构连贯性，即视角一致性。尽管扩散模型推动了新视角合成的发展，但它们仍难以保持跨视角的空间连续性。为应对这一问题，扩散模型已与3D模型结合，但此类方法因复杂的多步骤流程而效率低下。本文提出了一种新颖的视角一致图像生成方法，该方法利用扩散模型且无需额外模块。我们的关键思想是通过一种无需训练的方法增强扩散模型，该方法利用视角引导的扭曲来实现自适应注意力操作和噪声重新初始化，从而确保视角一致性。通过我们适用于新视角数据集的综合评估框架，我们展示了该方法在不同扩散模型上提升了视角一致性，证明了其广泛的适用性。项目页面：jwoo-park0.github.io/wave
tldr_zh: 提出无需训练的WAVE方法，利用视角引导扭曲增强扩散模型，提升单图新视角合成的一致性。
cover_zh: 单图生成新视角总崩？这个无需训练的方法让扩散模型秒变一致！
